What To Expect
Consider before submitting an application:  

This position is expected to start around January 2027 and continue through the entire Spring term (ending approximately May 2027 or later, if available). We ask for a minimum of 12 weeks, full-time (40 hours/week) and on-site, for most internships. Our internship program is for students who are actively enrolled in an academic program. Recent graduates seeking employment after graduation and not returning to school should apply for full-time positions, not internships.

International Students: If your work authorization is through CPT, please consult your school on your ability to work 40 hours per week before applying. You must be able to work 40 hours per week on-site. Many students will be limited to part-time during the academic year.

About The Team
Tesla is seeking passionate software engineering students who thrive in a fast-paced environment and want to apply CS concepts to real world projects. Our Software Engineering teams are responsible for many of Tesla’s innovations.

What You'll Do
Your application will be considered across all opportunities for the teams listed below:

Applications Engineering

- We are currently looking for an intern to help architect, build, manage and operate the Infrastructure & applications for Tesla’s Engineering teams including Connected Systems, Firmware and Autopilot. In this role, you will plan, design, implement as well as manage ongoing Infrastructure components that powers the development of Tesla’s Vehicles and technologies


Business Ops & Infrastructure

- The Infrastructure Engineering team designs and implements a diverse set of services and tools that power our internal software and processes. The projects you support will have a significant impact on the business and will allow us to grow at exceptional speeds. A strong candidate will either be an excellent software generalist, or experience in fullstack


What You'll Bring


- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field with a graduation date between 2027-2028
- Proficiency in one or more of the following developer skills: Python, Go, Java, C/C++ or other common industry languages
- Experience with building and/or maintaining infrastructure and services
- Excellent grasp of fundamental computer science concepts and ability to write well-organized code
- Eagerness to collaborate cross-functionally with other engineering teams while able to work independently; detail-oriented and execution focused
- Genuine curiosity and willingness to understand how our products are designed, built and how they operate
- Nice to haves: React, JS, Angular, CSS MySQL, MS SQL, Oracle


Benefits
As a full-time Tesla Intern, you will be eligible for:

-  Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
-  Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
-  Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans. Both have an option with a $0 payroll contribution
-  Company Paid (Health Savings Account) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High Deductible Medical Plan with HSA
-  Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
-  401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
-  Company Paid Basic Life, AD&D, and short-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
-  Employee Assistance Program
-  Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions), and Paid Holidays
-  Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
-  Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
-  Commuter benefits
-  Employee discounts and perks program
-  Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)


Expected Compensation

$42.00 - $58.00 + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

  
  

This internship is a full-time winter position scheduled for January 2027, with a hybrid work model requiring three days per week onsite at the Dorval office. It is embedded within a software development environment that emphasizes Scrum Agile methodology, fostering iterative development, continuous feedback, and collaborative workflows. The primary focus is on embedded software development, specifically aimed at enhancing and maintaining embedded firmware and software systems

  
  

**Responsibilities**

The intern will become an integral member of a specialized embedded software team, contributing to improving software quality through the implementation of new procedures, structures, and tools. The role involves hands-on development, validation, and documentation tasks aligned with team priorities.

  
  

* Design and help add firmware validation tests, and support and enhance connected equipment through C# software for an automated production test bench.
* Implement automated integration tests using a firmware simulator for emergency lighting charging, monitoring and control.
* Contribute to a variety of software and firmware tasks, such as designing software tools, investigating issues, adding unit tests, preparing documentation, reviewing code and other activities based on requests and priorities.
* Technical Documentation: Validate and enhance technical documentation for clarity, traceability, and maintainability. Support knowledge transfer and facilitate future development efforts.
  

  

**Requirements**

The ideal candidate must demonstrate a comprehensive set of technical competencies and linguistic proficiency:

  
  

Programming Languages & Frameworks:

* C, C++, C# with experience in GUI and command-line application development.
* Excel VBA for automation within spreadsheets.
* PowerShell scripting or batch files (considered assets for automation tasks).
  

  

Version Control & Testing:

* Git for source code management.
* Experience with unit testing and integration testing frameworks.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines to facilitate continuous integration and deployment.
  

  

Embedded Systems & Microcontrollers:

* Knowledge of embedded environments, such as STMicroelectronics and Silicon Labs families, is an asset.
  

  

Development Environment & Tools:

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Word and Excel.
* Ability to design and interpret electrical schematics, critical for embedded system validation and hardware-software integration.
* Collaborative mindset and willingness to learn within an Agile Scrum environment.
* Ability to adapt to evolving project demands and work effectively in a team setting.
* French is required. English is also required to communicate with customers outside Quebec on a regular basis and to to facilitate communication within the team and documentation.
  

  

**Why ABB?**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

  
  

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

#LI-hybrid

  

Employment Equity & Inclusion Statement (Canada)

ABB values the dedication, commitment, and expertise of all our employees. As an Employment Equity Employer, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We actively support the principles of the Employment Equity Act and strive to build a workforce that reflects Canada’s diversity, including:

* Women

* Indigenous Peoples

* Members of visible minorities

* Persons with disabilities

ABB is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we encourage you to let us know.

About Our Internship Program

Zoox’s internship program offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology, mentorship from some of the industry’s brightest minds, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to real projects. We seek interns who demonstrate strong academic performance, engagement beyond the classroom, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine interest in Zoox’s mission.
 
Job Description

The Business Applications team within Information Technology & Applications partners across Zoox to design, integrate, and optimize the enterprise systems and data workflows that keep our operations running smoothly. As a Supply Chain Data Analyst Intern, you will help bridge business systems and operational execution by turning complex supply chain, logistics, procurement, production, and quality data into clear, actionable insights.


In this Role, You Will…:
• Analyze data across supply chain, logistics, procurement, production, and quality processes to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement. 

• Build and maintain structured reports, trackers, and analytical models using Google Sheets (pivot tables, VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP , and advanced formulas) and SAP data. 

• Apply AI tools and data-driven approaches to streamline business application workflows and support operational decision-making. 

• Partner cross-functionally with Business Applications and Supply Chain stakeholders to translate business questions into reliable data outputs.

Internship Requirements:
• Currently working towards a Master’s or MBA degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. 

• Good academic standing and enrolled at an accredited college or university throughout the internship. 

• Able to commit to a full-time, 12-week internship. 

• Ability to relocate to the Bay Area, California, for the duration of the internship. 

• Interns at Zoox may not use any proprietary information they are working on as part of their thesis, any published work with their university, or to be distributed to anyone outside of Zoox.

Qualifications:
• Foundational knowledge of supply chain, logistics, procurement, production, and quality processes. 

• Strong proficiency in Google Sheets (including pivot tables, VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP , and formulas) for data analysis and reporting. 

• Familiarity with SAP or enterprise business applications. 

• Experience or coursework leveraging AI tools for data analysis or process optimization. 

• Strong analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, and communication skills.

Bonus Qualifications:
• Experience with Data Science methodologies or tools. 

• Familiarity with Quality Control data and reporting.

Compensation 
 
The monthly salary range for this position is $5,500 to $9,500. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level of education. Additional benefits may include medical insurance and a housing stipend (relocation assistance will be offered based on eligibility).Interview Process & Duration of Each Interview


About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.
